Support quality checks, inspections, and improvements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize production processes.

High school diploma (MBO4+) or equivalent.
2+ years of experience in implantable stent production or 4+ years in cleanroom work (preferred).
Experience in quality inspection or stent production is a bonus.

Proficiency in Excel and general computer tools.')
